verdicts.reason: A keeps the product badge intact but jams it into the top-left corner. The text, NEW pill and Try It button sit in a band across the middle, with Try It nearly touching the right edge and NEW crowding the headline, leaving the bottom ~40% of the canvas dead orange. B breaks the key graphic: the cream circle is pulled away from the can and shoved into the bottom-left corner, half off-canvas, so the can outline vanishes orange-on-orange. B's headline is also undersized for the canvas, Try It is off the text column's left edge, and NEW floats alone in the top-right corner.
